cards.claim: Joint optimization of training and testing resolutions improves performance
cards.conditions: ImageNet classification, EfficientNet models, fine-tuning at test resolution
cards.effect: +0.5% to +2% absolute top-1 accuracy across model sizes
cards.evidence: Tables 1-2 show systematic improvements; FixEfficientNet-B0 achieves 79.3% vs 77.6% baseline
cards.quote: Touvron et al. show [1] that this separate optimization has a detrimental effect on the test-time performance of models. They address this problem with the FixRes method, which jointly optimizes the choice of resolutions and scales at training and test time

cards.claim: Training-test resolution mismatch arises from different Region of Classification sampling
cards.conditions: Standard ImageNet preprocessing with random crops at train time, center crops at test time
cards.effect: Skews data distribution seen by CNN between train and test
cards.evidence: Described in Introduction as the core problem motivating FixRes
cards.quote: Thus, while the crops extracted at training and test time have the same size, they arise from different RoCs, which skews the data distribution seen by the CNN.

cards.claim: Resolution-dependent fine-tuning is neutral to overfitting status
cards.conditions: Fine-tuning only top layers at target resolution, same augmentation as FixRes
cards.effect: Overfitted models remain overfitted; non-overfitted remain non-overfitted (no overfitting change)
cards.evidence: Demonstrated by comparing relative model ordering on ImageNet vs ImageNet-V2
cards.quote: The FixRes fine-tuning procedure is neutral with respect to overfitting: overfitted models remain overfitted and conversely.

cards.claim: Higher test resolution improves accuracy despite matching train resolution distribution
cards.conditions: EfficientNet models, single-crop evaluation, fine-tuned from pre-trained weights
cards.effect: Accuracy gains of +1.7% (B0), +1.8% (B8) on ImageNet with 300M unlabeled pretraining
cards.evidence: Table 1 shows systematic gains across all model scales
cards.quote: For instance, our FixEfficientNet-B0 trained without additional training data achieves 79.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with 5.3M parameters. This is a +0.5% absolute improvement over the Noisy student EfficientNet-B0 trained with 300M unlabeled images.
